## Plugin reference

- Description: Last-resort renderer for a file no other renderer offers to show (binary formats): a large file icon, "No preview for <kind> files", and Open with default app for a host file.
- Web:
  - Contributes: `FileViewer.Renderer` "Info" → `NoPreview`
  - Uses:
    - `primitives/file-viewer.FileViewer`
    - `primitives/file-viewer.NoPreview`
